text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 23, 2024) for 1915 Martin Grove Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 23, 2024) for 1915 Martin Grove Road, Folder Number 24 216358 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
